summary: Independent, isolation-verified GitHub Copilot review accepted the combined #3326, #3337, #3345 and #3362 EC candidate. It found exact copied-inventory drift falsifiers; fail-closed evidence parsing and cross-surface readiness checks; a real service subprocess with route, Server-Timing and SIGTERM-drain assertions; and default full self-health with isolated smoke/payload plus pre-spawn same-project recursion rejection.
